0022600229.text: The Timberwolves host the Mavericks in their 12th game of the season, sitting at 8-3 overall and 4-1 at home, on a four-game winning streak and 7-3 over their last ten, and they are 4th in the West and half a game behind for 2nd in the Northwest. Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) are out for Minnesota, while Dallas, at 6-4 and 10th in the West, has won two straight and is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Timberwolves swept the 2025-26 series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 124-94 Minnesota win in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
